<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/sync/v2/link"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Trades the short login session the client just signed in with for a long lived device session, which shows in the account's sessions list and is revoked like any other. The login session is ended. clientType and deviceId are optional and default to desktop and none.

<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>

</ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema
  title={"Body"}
  body={{"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"deviceName":{"type":"string"},"clientType":{"type":"string","enum":["desktop","mobile","web","cli","master"]},"deviceId":{"type":"string"}}}}}}}
>
  
</RequestSchema>

<StatusCodes
  responses={{"200":{"description":"The device session token and the account it belongs to."},"401":{"description":"Not signed in."},"403":{"description":"API keys cannot link a client."}}}
>
  
</StatusCodes>
